title: Gluten Free Bakery Market to Grow from USD 4.84 Billion in 2025 to USD 11.97 Billion by 2035, at 9.48% CAGR – SNS Insider
author: Sns Insider
description: The global gluten-free bakery market is projected to grow at a 9.48% CAGR from 2025 to 2035, driven by rising celiac disease diagnoses, increased health consciousness, and innovations in alternative flours. North America leads with 42.10% market share, while Asia Pacific emerges as the fastest-growing region. Bread dominates product types, rice flour leads flour varieties, and online retail is the fastest-growing distribution channel.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Listed as a major key player in the expanding gluten-free bakery market, which is projected to grow at 9.48% CAGR through 2035, indicating growth opportunities for established diversified food manufacturers.
Listed as a major player through its Canyon Bakehouse brand in the gluten-free segment, positioned to benefit from the market's 9.48% CAGR growth and expanding online retail channels.
Major key player in a high-growth market segment with strong tailwinds from rising health consciousness and celiac disease awareness, particularly in emerging markets like Asia Pacific.

title: For Students Like Jariel: Stop & Shop Launches Annual School Food Pantry Campaign
author: Stop & Shop
description: Stop & Shop announced its annual School Food Pantry Campaign running from September 4 through October 30, 2026, allowing customers to donate at checkout to support school food pantries across five states. The program, established in 2019, now supports over 290 schools serving more than 50,000 students and families monthly, with plans to reach 300 partner schools. The campaign features five student and family ambassadors whose stories highlight the program's impact on food-insecure communities.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Campbell's is recognized as a premier program partner supporting Stop & Shop's school food pantry initiative, contributing to nutritious food access for students and families in need.
General Mills, through its Cheerios brand, is acknowledged as a key vendor partner helping stock school pantries with nutritious options, demonstrating corporate commitment to food security.
Coca-Cola, through its smartwater brand, is listed as a premier partner supporting the school food pantry program, contributing to the initiative's success.

title: Regenerative Lifestyle Products Industry Analysis Report 2026-2035 Featuring Profiles of Global, Regional, Niche & Specialist Players
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The global regenerative lifestyle products market is projected to grow from USD 4.5 billion in 2025 to USD 15.2 billion by 2035 at a CAGR of 12.7%, driven by increased consumer demand for sustainable products, certified sourcing practices, and direct-to-consumer channels. The food and beverage segment leads with 45.7% market share, while online distribution channels represent the fastest-growing sales channel. Premium pricing remains a challenge for mainstream adoption, though supply chain maturation is expected to improve affordability.

title: Pet Treats Market to Grow from USD 38.40 Billion in 2026 to USD 58.71 Billion by 2031, at a CAGR of 8.9% — MarketsandMarkets™
author: Marketsandmarkets™
description: The global pet treats market is projected to grow at a CAGR of 8.9% from USD 38.40 billion in 2026 to USD 58.71 billion by 2031, driven by increasing pet ownership, pet humanization, and rising demand for premium, functional treats with natural ingredients. Jerky and meat-based treats dominate the market, while freeze-dried products and e-commerce channels show the fastest growth. Asia Pacific is expected to be the fastest-growing region.
